== Summary ==
Players Committee legacy virtual-card slip PDF ''Virtual Block 8: Agents For Hire'' (cover: official text as of 14 September 2012), as reposted on the Players Committee forum in 2022 after the PC stopped hosting the pre-reset blocks on its main page. The poster notes he is not sure these are the original releases. It is the same document as the official <code>VirtualBlock8_2.pdf</code> cited on [[Virtual Block 8]], but the file bytes differ from the archived official copy.

* '''Date posted:''' 2022-05-10
* '''Pages:''' 4

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1376415#p1376415 Original 17 VSet PDFs &amp; Pre-Reset Block PDFs], post 1376415, by Throdo, 2022-05-10. Original attachment name: b8_2.pdf (9,794,770 bytes); forum attachment id 16726. The forum attachment link is behind Cloudflare: it has no Wayback capture, and a Save Page Now request on 22 November 2026 failed.
* '''Posted by:''' Throdo
